The text extracted from the PDF appears to be a notice from the Office of the Registrar at Babu Banarasi Das University, approved by the University Grants Commission under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956. 

The address of the university is at BBD City, Ayodhya Road, Lucknow 226028, Uttar Pradesh, India, and can be contacted at +91-(522)-6196222, 6196223. 

A copy of this letter is referenced as BBDU/Reg./ADMIN/ACAD-CAL/75 dated December 08, 2025.

The following notice is regarding the academic calendar for the even semester of the 2025-26 academic session, which applies to all programs except for the Dental Sciences program.

The events listed in the notice are as follows:

The academic classes and registration for the even semester of the 2025-26 academic session are scheduled to commence on January 05, 2026.

About 25% of all courses must have been taught by January 27, 2026.

The last date for submission of the university examination form to the department will be determined by a notification.

By February 17, 2026, students should have completed about 50% of all courses.

By February 23, 2026, students must have completed the Continuous Internal Assessment (CIA) or Sessional Test – I, which is compulsory for all students.

By March 25, 2026, students should have completed approximately 75% of all courses.

By April 15, 2026, students must have completed the Continuous Internal Assessment (CIA) or Sessional Test – II, which is compulsory for all students.

By April 27, 2026, students should have completed 100% of all courses.

Admit cards for the even semester university examinations will be issued to eligible students between April 28 and 30, 2026.

University even semester theory and practical examinations will take place between May 05 and June 05, 2026.

The academic classes for the odd semester of the 2026-27 academic session (excluding the first-year students) are scheduled to commence on July 15, 2026.

The notice is signed by Dr. Sudharma Singh, the Registrar of Babu Banarasi Das University in Lucknow.

The University's fee structure for various courses includes strict rules on payment. According to the university's rules:

   - There is no separate tuition fee mentioned.
   - The collaboration charges are 250/- Rupees per year.

   - There is no separate tuition fee mentioned.
   - The collaboration charges are 250/- Rupees per year.

Here is the rewritten version of the text as clear, complete sentences:

The Babu Banarasi Das University in Lucknow has provided the yearly/semestral fee structure for the academic session 2026-27. 

It's essential to note that this fee structure does not include hostel, mess, bus, or uniform charges. 

Payment instructions are as follows:

For all courses, except those collaborated with IBM or IITs, payment should be made in favor of "Babu Banarasi Das University" payable at Lucknow.

For courses collaborated with IBM or IITs (Minor Degrees), the collaboration fee must be paid through NEFT/Demand Draft drawn in favor of "Learnovate Enterprises LLP" payable at Lucknow.

For students seeking admission in the lateral entry mode in B. Tech., B. Arch., and B. Pharm. courses, they will have to pay all the charges applicable for first-year students in other courses, including tuition fees, examination fees, sessional examination fees, and student welfare funds, in addition to the tuition fees.

An online registration fee of Rs. 500 will be charged, which will be adjusted at the time of admission in the application form charges.

It is essential to note that online registration does not guarantee admission to the applied course.

At the time of admission, a student will have to pay the following fees:

* Application form- Rs. 2,000
* Membership Alumni Association Fee - Rs. 2,000
* Student Welfare Fund - Rs. 500
* Caution Money (Refundable) - Rs. 5,000

Additionally, PhD registration fees of Rs. 10,000 (one-time) will be charged at the time of PhD registration after completing the coursework, and PhD thesis submission fees of Rs. 25,000 (one-time) will be charged at the time of thesis submission.

Regarding the Learnovate Training Fee, students will have to pay the following fees:

- For B. Tech. (all branches), first-year students will pay Rs. 3,000 per semester for technical training, second-year students will pay Rs. 3,000 per semester for technical training and personality development, and third-year students will pay Rs. 3,000 per semester for technical training and personality development.
- For BBA, BBA-LSCM, BBA-BA, and B. Com. (Hons.), second-year students will pay Rs. 2,500 in the third semester for personality development and training, and third-year students will pay Rs. 2,500 in the fifth semester for training and placement.
- For BCA, BCA (DSAI), BCA (CS&F), and B. Sc., second-year students will pay Rs. 3,000 in the third semester for personality development and training, and third-year students will pay Rs. 3,000 in the fifth semester for training and placement.
- For MBA, first-year students will pay Rs. 3,000 in the second semester for personality development and training, and second-year students will pay Rs. 3,000 in the third semester for training and placement.
- For IMBA, second-year students will pay Rs. 2,500 in the fourth semester for personality development and training, third-year students will pay Rs. 3,000 in the sixth semester for training and placement, and final-year students will pay Rs. 3,000 in the seventh semester for training and placement.
- For MCA and MCA (DSAI), first-year students will pay Rs. 3,000 in the second semester for personality development and training, and second-year students will pay Rs. 3,000 in the third semester for training and placement.

A degree fee of Rs. 2,000 will be charged along with the final semester fee of every course of BBD University.

The students of B. Tech, BCA, BBA, B. Com. (Hons.), and IMBA programs who opt for a minor degree offered by IIT-Mandi in collaboration with Masai School and NSDC will pay a fee of Rs. 15,000 in the 3rd, 4th, and 5th semesters in which the program will be offered.

The students of MCA and MBA who opt for a minor degree will pay a fee of Rs. 15,000 in the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd semesters in which the program will be offered. The minor degree options include:

1. Minor in Artificial Intelligence
2. Minor in CSE & Advanced Tech
3. Minor in Data Science
4. Minor in Business Analytics

The updated fee structure has been provided for information purposes, and copies have been sent to the following parties:

1. Chief Executive Director, BBD Educational Group - For kind information
2. Vice Chancellor, BBD University, Lucknow - For kind information
3. PS to Hon'ble Chancellor, BBD University, Lucknow - For kind information
4. Controller of Examination, BBD University, Lucknow
5. Accounts Department, BBD University, Lucknow
6. Guard File.

REGISTRAR,
B.B.D. UNIVERSITY,
LUCKNOW,
